events.name: The Quiet Figure
events.intro: At the edge of a Rocket scene stands a quiet figure with a notebook. Ein. He is not wearing a Rocket uniform, and he is not writing down what Rocket says. He is writing down what the Capture Rig hums. "The pulse is not theirs," he murmurs. "I would like to show you the reading."

success.text: Ein sets down the notebook. "Then let us settle it the old way."

choices.label: Let him read your Shadow Pokémon

success.text: Ein listens to the haze for a long moment and nods. He tears out a page and hands you a Data ROM.
Ein closes the notebook and fades into the crowd.

events.name: Crates With the Same Stencil
events.intro: Crates on the dock all carry the same stencil: a small violet mark that is not Rocket's, not Aqua's, not anyone's you know. A Cipher Peon is guarding them and trying very hard to look like a dockworker.

success.text: "Nothing to see here. The fountain is just very clean."
You note the stencil and walk on.
